front.title: The otpauth URI Scheme: One-Time Password (OTP) Credential Provisioning

abstract.t:
This document defines syntax and processing rules for the otpauth: URI scheme used to provision one-time-password (OTP) credentials (verification codes) for HOTP and TOTP.
This document defines a common baseline for interoperability, including issuer handling rules that improve account matching while maintaining compatibility with existing deployments. It does not preclude future extensions for other OTP methods.
